_about: Region context added to every advisory prompt. Seasons follow the Indian cropping calendar (Kharif: June-October, Rabi: November-March, Zaid: March-June). Helpline: Kisan Call Centre 1800-180-1551 (toll free, all states).

kharif.risk: Monsoon rain and high humidity favour fungal and bacterial diseases (blights, leaf spots, downy mildew), stem borers and planthoppers. Spray between showers; add a sticker to the spray.

rabi.risk: Cool nights and fog favour late blight, rusts and powdery mildew; aphids build up in winter.

zaid.risk: Hot, dry weather favours mites, thrips and whiteflies (and leaf curl viruses); water stress makes plants more susceptible.

India (general).notes: Contact the nearest Krishi Vigyan Kendra (KVK) for locally approved products.

Andhra Pradesh.notes: Rice, chilli, cotton and mango areas; watch chilli thrips and leaf curl.

Assam.notes: Rice and tea; frequent rain makes protective fungicide sprays important.

Bihar.notes: Rice-wheat, maize and potato; foggy winters raise late blight risk in potato.

Gujarat.notes: Cotton, groundnut and mango; sucking pests and mites in dry periods.

Haryana.notes: Rice-wheat system; yellow rust and aphids in wheat during cool winters.

Himachal Pradesh.notes: Apple, stone fruit and vegetables; apple scab and rust risk in wet springs.

Jammu and Kashmir.notes: Apple and saffron; apple scab is the key spring disease.

Karnataka.notes: Maize, tomato, grape and mango; fall armyworm in maize.

Kerala.notes: Coconut, banana, pepper and rice; long wet seasons favour fungal diseases.

Madhya Pradesh.notes: Soybean, wheat and chickpea; soybean rust and girdle beetle in Kharif.

Maharashtra.notes: Cotton, soybean, grape, onion and citrus; grape downy mildew in rainy spells, citrus greening in Vidarbha.

Odisha.notes: Rice; brown planthopper and stem borer outbreaks in Kharif.

Punjab.notes: Rice-wheat and potato; potato late blight in foggy December-January.

Rajasthan.notes: Bajra, mustard and pulses; locust alerts in western districts, aphids on mustard.

Tamil Nadu.notes: Rice, banana, tomato and sugarcane; leaf curl and whiteflies in summer vegetables.

Telangana.notes: Cotton, rice, maize and chilli; pink bollworm in cotton, thrips in chilli.

Uttar Pradesh.notes: Wheat, rice, sugarcane, potato and mango; mango hoppers at flowering.

Uttarakhand.notes: Apple, vegetables and rice; wet springs favour scab and leaf spots.

West Bengal.notes: Rice, potato, jute and vegetables; potato late blight in winter fog.
